theme: TP-3 tuple payloads of Some/Ok/Err typed
text: CHECKER (infer.rs, all engines): a tuple pattern inside Some/Ok/Err is bound against the subject's payload type when that type is already known (Option<(..)>, Result<(..), E>), so its shape and its components are checked as a top-level tuple pattern's are (numeric leaves stay free: an int component used as u8 still checks). Check-clean run panics such as Some((a, b)) on Some((1, "s")) with b + 1 are E0102. New refusals of programs that run: a dead arm whose payload tuple has another length (Some((a, b)) on Some((1, 2, 3)), Ok((a, b)) on Result<(i64, i64, i64), str>). Other inner patterns are unchanged. The 717 tracked .ax files check with the same exit codes as the base binary.
